requirements.label: Buyer job and complete primary journey
requirements.acceptance: Named buyer and outcome; a new user completes the primary task, including recovery, with observed evidence.

requirements.label: Design direction and interface states
requirements.acceptance: Approved visual direction, tokens, real content, responsive layouts, empty/loading/error/success states and purposeful motion.

requirements.label: Asset provenance and usable identity
requirements.acceptance: Asset rights and source records; logo tested small and in monochrome; actual vector master if a vector is promised; optimized image exports.

requirements.label: Domain, DNS and deployment ownership
requirements.acceptance: Named account owner, renewal record, canonical host, TLS, staging protections, DNS change/rollback packet and independent endpoint checks.

requirements.label: Search and answer discoverability
requirements.acceptance: Crawl/render/index checks, canonical and sitemap review, truthful structured data, source-backed pages, crawler decisions and measurement baseline.

requirements.label: Accessibility in the actual journey
requirements.acceptance: Keyboard, focus, forms, screen-reader sampling, contrast, zoom/reflow, touch and reduced-motion checks; automated scan supplemented manually.

requirements.label: Performance with representative content
requirements.acceptance: Repeatable mobile lab conditions, payload budgets and layout stability; field LCP/INP/CLS separately recorded when sufficient traffic exists.

requirements.label: Security and data boundaries
requirements.acceptance: Secret and dependency checks, threat review, consent/data inventory, least privilege, retention and deletion behavior proportionate to the product.

requirements.label: Repeatable install and delivery
requirements.acceptance: Clean install/customize/deploy rehearsal, version matrix, license, entitlement if relevant, support path and rollback to a known revision.

requirements.label: Ownership after launch
requirements.acceptance: Named operator, actionable alerts, backup/restore where data exists, renewal and update schedule, incident runbook, handoff and offboarding.

requirements.label: Independent review of this revision
requirements.acceptance: Reviewer differs from maker; findings and repairs attached. Host release gates and paid-product cold execution remain separate obligations.

requirements.label: Authentication and authorization
requirements.acceptance: Session lifecycle, recovery, role checks on server, abuse limits and forbidden-path tests using separate test identities.

requirements.label: Data, jobs and migrations
requirements.acceptance: Schema migrations, durable jobs/retries, idempotency, retention/export/deletion and demonstrated backup restore.

requirements.label: Purchase through refund and entitlement
requirements.acceptance: Provider test environment; signed webhooks, duplicates/out-of-order events, failed payment, cancellation/refund and access reconciliation.

requirements.label: Transactional and marketing email
requirements.acceptance: Domain authentication, delivery test, retry/duplicate behavior, bounce handling, appropriate unsubscribe and recovery independent of marketing consent.

requirements.label: Tenant isolation across every access path
requirements.acceptance: Two-tenant negative tests for storage, database, retrieval, exports, background jobs and logs; support access is bounded and recorded.

requirements.label: Agent behavior, permissions and economics
requirements.acceptance: Representative and adversarial evals, schema/tool validation, scoped credentials, confirmation for consequential actions, budgets, cancellation, durable state and trace review.

requirements.label: Locale content and behavior
requirements.acceptance: Translated content reviewed, locale routing/hreflang and reciprocal links checked; currencies/dates/time zones and language fallback tested.
